name: Performance Grapher
description: Performance Grapher for CORSAIR XENEON Edge. Monitor iCUE sensor history with graph, bar, radial, or readout views, optional live FPS and frametime statistics, and an optional HTTPS response-time indicator. Customize sensor scales, sampling, warnings, typography, colors, header sizing, sensor readout sizing, and background transparency while keeping local history on this PC.
release_notes: 1.4.1 stability and readability update. Fixes background transparency becoming excessively see-through after changing XENEON dashboard pages, restores sensor titles to use all available space up to the actual readout instead of truncating early, strengthens temperature-unit containment when FPS is disabled, uses the hardened direct iCUE settings binding path, and keeps the sensor readout/header sizing, HTTPS response-time display, and product-line accent polish.
